- Violates MVVM pattern

- Route all changes through SiteViewModel

title: GH#3: Convert FileNode from class to struct
description:
Refactor: FileNode is @Observable class but should be a struct.

Current problems:
- Requires weak parent reference to avoid retain cycles
- More memory overhead than value type
- Harder to reason about mutations

Proposed solution:
- Convert to struct with parent ID reference instead of object reference
- Use central store/index for parent lookup

Note: Major refactor affecting all FileNode usages.

Files: Victor/Models/FileNode.swift and all dependent files

GitHub Issue: https://github.com/karanj/victor/issues/3

title: Consider refactoring FileNode to reduce @Observable overhead
description:
Long-term consideration: Evaluate removing @Observable from FileNode or converting to struct for better performance.

Location: Victor/Models/FileNode.swift

Current Issue:
- FileNode is @Observable class, making every property change observable
- Reference type overhead for observation tracking
- Changes propagate through entire tree
- SwiftUI must track all instances

Options:
A) Make FileNode a struct (major refactor)
   - Better performance but complex migration
   - Would require significant tree structure changes

B) Remove @Observable from FileNode
   - Only SiteViewModel needs to be @Observable
   - FileNode can be plain class
   - Manually trigger updates in SiteViewModel

Expected Impact: 5-10% overall performance improvement
Risk: High (requires careful architectural changes)
Note: Evaluate necessity after implementing Phase 1-3 optimizations
